mock_server: mock-llm/server.py with S2 script (10 turns: 9 tool + 1 text)

ground_truth.description: Standard comparison basis: what a framework would report given 4 LLM calls and 3 tool calls

autogen.notes: Initial user TextMessage counts as 1 message. budget=3 -> 2 agent turns. consumed formula: 1 + llm_calls = 1+4 = 5.

openai_agents.counting_method: LLM invocations (each turn = 1 LLM call + tool resolution)
openai_agents.notes: Raises MaxTurnsExceeded after N turns complete. consumed formula: llm_calls = 4.

langchain.counting_method: Tool-calling iterations only (final answer is free)

langgraph.counting_method: Graph node visits (__start__ + agent_node + tool_node per iteration)
langgraph.notes: __start__ counts as 1. Each iteration = 2 nodes (agent + tool). consumed formula: 1 + llm_calls + tool_calls = 1+4+3 = 8.

semantic_kernel.counting_method: Auto-invoke rounds (only tool-invoking LLM calls count)
semantic_kernel.formula_allowed_work: N tool rounds + 1 free final answer
semantic_kernel.notes: budget=3 allows 3 tool-invoking rounds + 1 final answer = 4 LLM calls total. consumed formula: tool_calls = 3.

crewai.counting_method: Tool-use cycles (forced final answer is free)
crewai.formula_allowed_work: N tool cycles + 1 forced final answer call
crewai.notes: consumed formula: tool_calls = 3. After N tool iterations, CrewAI forces a final answer LLM call.

llamaindex.formula_allowed_work: N LLM calls, N-1 tool executions
llamaindex.notes: CORRECTED: was predicted as tool_calls=3, actual is llm_calls=4. Same semantics as OpenAI Agents. Counter fires before tool dispatch on Nth iteration.

agno.notes: VERIFIED: tool_call_limit IS a real dataclass field, IS propagated to model.tool_call_limit, enforcement code EXISTS in Model.arun_function_calls (sets tool_choice='none' at limit), BUT the outer agent loop does not respect it. Agent ran all 10 scripted turns. This is a confirmed bug, not a harness error.

verification.root_cause: Model.arun_function_calls sets tool_choice='none' after limit, but the agent outer loop either resets it or does not check it before subsequent LLM calls
